name: mine hit fades preserve Sprite animation state
lua_assertions:
local path="crates/deadsync-noteskin/tests/fixtures/shock-mine/Down HitMine Explosion 16x1.png"
native_sprite:Load(path)
assert(native_sprite:GetNumStates()==16)
native_sprite:addcommand("Init",function(self) self:diffusealpha(0):zoom(1.5):SetAllStateDelays(0.05) end)
native_sprite:addcommand("HitMine",function(self) self:finishtweening():diffusealpha(1):sleep(0.3):linear(0.3):diffusealpha(0) end)
native_sprite:playcommand("Init")
assert(math.abs(native_sprite:GetAnimationLengthSeconds()-0.8)<0.000001)
for frame=0,15 do
 native_sprite:SetSecondsIntoAnimation((frame+0.5)*0.05)
 assert(native_sprite:GetState()==frame,"initial state "..frame)
 native_sprite:playcommand("HitMine")
 assert(native_sprite:GetState()==frame,"HitMine preserves state "..frame)
end
native_sprite:addcommand("Reset",function(self) self:setstate(0):diffusealpha(1) end)
native_sprite:playcommand("Reset")
assert(native_sprite:GetState()==0,"an explicit seek resets the state")
native_sprite:addcommand("ResetTime",function(self) self:SetSecondsIntoAnimation(0.175):diffusealpha(1) end)
native_sprite:playcommand("ResetTime")
assert(native_sprite:GetState()==3,"an explicit time seek selects its frame")
